p: run before him: Which were as a guard to set forth his estate.
tribes of Israel: That is, noting of what city or place he was.
Oh that I were made judge: Thus by slander, flattery and fair promises, the wicked seek preference.
stole the hearts of the men: By enticing them from his father to himself.
forty years: Counting from the time that the Israelites had asked a king of Samuel.
serve the LORD: By offering a peace-offering, which was lawful to do in any place.
called: And bid to his feast in Hebron.
Absalom: Whose heart he saw that Satan had so possessed that he would leave no mischief unattempted.
far off: That is, from Jerusalem.
Cherethites: These were as the king's guard, or as some write, his counsellors.
Ittai the Gittite: Who as some write was the king's son of Gath.
brethren: Meaning, those of his family.
truth be with thee: God require of you your friendship and fidelity.
all the people passed over: That is, the four hundred men.
bearing the ark of the covenant: Which was the charge, of the Kohathites, Nu 4:4.
up: To stand by the ark.
here am I: The faithful in all their afflictions show themselves obedient to God's will.
covered: With ashes and dust in sign of sorrow.
counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness: The counsel of the crafty worldlings does more harm than the open force of the enemy.
servant: Though Hushai was deceitful here at the king's request, we may not use this example to excuse our deceit.
